scope: Exact Lean contract only; native Rust parsing/arithmetic/cardinality and polynomial/complete-cost bridges are not proved. Statement fidelity is a reviewer obligation.
statement: Over a field K with finitely many columns and arbitrary rows, if Mz=rhs, Mh=0 and h[target]=1, then z+h also satisfies the retained equations and its target coordinate differs from z[target]. This concerns linear equations, not multiple curve logarithms.
